privateBootstrap.password: Not included here. Read only the private access file.

parentActions: Read server/CONTRACT.json for exact request and response shapes.
Complete the frontend and run npm run build.
Start node server/index.mjs on port 5300 using the parent's server-start workflow; the backend is not currently left running by this subagent.
Use __PORT_5300__ for preview API requests and same-origin /api URLs for the standalone server.
Use credentials: omit and keep the bearer token only in JavaScript memory.
Share the private access file only with the owner; do not put its contents into source code, screenshots, or public artifacts.
Perform frontend/browser QA and any requested deployment in the parent workflow.
operationalNotes: The private access guide assumes the frontend inbox page is /inbox/. If the parent chooses another path, update only the non-secret navigation sentence in the guide accordingly.
No dependencies were installed, no browser was used, and no deployment, commit, portal access, or external-service call was made by this subagent.
No email or SMS notifications exist, and no such delivery is claimed.
Preview SQLite persistence is not production hosting or a durability guarantee.

Limits use process-salted in-memory client keys and reset on restart. Behind a proxy, configure TRUST_PROXY only for the real trusted proxy chain; default false does not trust spoofable forwarded headers.

Production should configure private persistent DATA_DIR and ADMIN_ACCESS_FILE locations, HTTPS, encrypted backup/restore, privacy retention, exact ALLOWED_ORIGINS if needed, ALLOW_OPAQUE_ORIGIN=false, and deliberate indexing settings.
The static manifest is loaded on startup; restart the server after replacing the build.
Password rotation is local-only: stop server, run node server/rotate-password.mjs --confirm, read the updated private file, then restart. It revokes sessions and preserves inquiries.
